user.title: Connect to Immich
user.description: Enter your Immich server details. Home Assistant will verify the connection before continuing.

source.title: Choose a photo source
source.description: Choose how this frame should select photos. Your other settings are kept when you change the source.

connection.title: Choose an Immich connection
connection.description: Reuse a saved server and API key, or connect to another server. The connection will be checked before continuing.

data_description.connection_id: Saved connections show the server URL and the name of a frame that uses it.

new_connection.title: Connect to another Immich server
new_connection.description: Enter the server URL and API key. These details will be available when you add more frames.

album.title: Choose Immich albums
album.description: Choose one or more albums from your Immich server. Photos from all selected albums will be shown together.

data_description.navigation: Choose an action, then use the button below. Going back keeps your selections; changes are applied only when you choose Save frame on the final step.

memories.title: Configure Memories
memories.description: Set the date range used to find memories around today.

data.fallback_to_all: Fall back to All photos when memories are empty

data_description.memory_window_days: How many days before and after today to check when using Memories.
data_description.fallback_to_all: Use the All photos source if Immich has no matching memories.
data_description.navigation: Choose an action, then use the button below. Going back keeps your selections; changes are applied only when you choose Save frame on the final step.

smart.title: Configure Keywords
smart.description: Enter keywords describing the photos you want to find.

data_description.smart_query: Enter a description such as “beach at sunset”.
data_description.navigation: Choose an action, then use the button below. Going back keeps your selections; changes are applied only when you choose Save frame on the final step.

display.title: Set up the frame
display.description: Name your frame, then save. Target display, photo preferences, slideshow interval and Memories preferences can be changed afterwards in settings.

data_description.screen_shape: Choose your EspControl device to match its output resolution. The 10.1-inch and 7-inch choices cover all panel revisions. The 10.1-inch display also has a portrait option. This does not change which photo orientations are selected.
data_description.mode: Show photos individually, or pair portrait photos from nearby dates side by side while keeping landscapes in the slideshow.
data_description.navigation: When editing an existing frame, choose an action, then use the button below. Going back keeps your selections.

photos.title: Configure photo display
photos.description: Choose which photo orientations to include, how photos fit and the slideshow interval. Save the frame here for single images, or continue to pairing settings when Pair portrait photos is selected.

data_description.orientation: Mixed includes landscapes and portraits by default, as well as square photos. Choose portrait photos only or landscape photos only to restrict the slideshow. This does not change the output size.
data_description.navigation: Choose an action, then use the button below. Going back keeps your selections; changes are applied only when you choose Save frame on the final step.
data_description.photo_fit: Crop to fit fills the frame by trimming photo edges. Show full image keeps the entire photo and fills any empty space with a dim colour from the photo. Applies to single photos and both photos in a pair.

pairing.title: Configure portrait pairs
pairing.description: Choose how closely the dates of paired photos should match, then use the button below to save the frame.

data_description.pair_window_days: The maximum number of days between the two portrait photos in a pair.
data_description.pairs_only: Skip portraits without a matching companion. Landscapes and square photos still appear individually when included by the orientation filter.
data_description.navigation: Choose an action, then use the button below. Going back keeps your selections; changes are applied only when you choose Save frame on the final step.

error.connection_unavailable: That saved connection is no longer available. Choose another connection or enter the server details again.
error.invalid_auth: Check the API key and its asset.read permission in Immich.
error.smart_query_required: Enter keywords describing the photos you want to find.
error.album_access_denied: Could not access albums. Check that your Immich API key is valid and has album.read permission, then choose Albums to retry.
error.albums_unavailable: Could not load albums from Immich. Choose Albums to retry, or select another photo source.
error.no_albums: No albums are available to this Immich account. Create or share an album in Immich, then choose Albums to retry, or select All photos.
error.album_unavailable: One or more selected albums are no longer available. Check the updated list and select the albums to use.
error.album_required: Choose at least one album to continue.
error.name_required: Enter a name for this frame.
error.name_in_use: Another frame on this server already uses this name. Choose a different name.

abort.already_configured: A frame with this name is already configured.
